items.description: Adds the `@williamthorsen/readout-journal` package, whose `withJournal` wraps a reducer so that each transition appends to the journal the domain events that a derivation function finds in the state before, the action, and the state after, and whose `serializeJournal` returns the journal as JSON. (#9)
Adds `EntryRenderers` and `renderEntry`, which render each journal entry through the renderer declared for its event type, so that the typecheck reports an event type that lacks a renderer. (#9)
